descriptions.description: Speak Business English Like an American

exercises.title: Choose the most appropriate response to the following:

question.text: 1. We purchased an entire office building in New York for a song a few years ago when the economy was bad.

options.option: Now that building would be much more expensive.
Now that building would be much cheaper.
Now you could probably get that building at a good price.

question.text: 2. Kim, our new finance manager, is the type of person who can take the ball and run with it.

options.option: Great, we need somebody here who needs a lot of direction.
Great, we need some more good athletes in our office.
Great, we're looking for somebody with initiative.

question.text: 3. Jesse won $5 million last month in a lawsuit. He really struck it rich.

options.option: No wonder he's decided to retire!
No wonder he's decided to go to law school!
No wonder he's decided to continue working!

question.text: 4. We're looking to hire somebody who'll stay with our company for at least a few years. You wouldn't jump ship after just a year, would you?

options.option: No, I don't even like sailing.
No, I always stay at jobs at least three years.
No, I would probably quit after a year.

question.text: 5. You might get rich investing in biotech companies, but you're just as likely to lose your shirt.

options.option: That's good advice. I'll definitely invest heavily in them.
That's true. I'd better be careful about putting too much money into them.
That's true, but I'd be willing to give away my shirt in exchange for a lot of money.

question.text: 6. While in Russia, you should snap up some lacquer boxes. They're beautiful and inexpensive there.

options.option: Okay, I will be sure to pack plenty of boxes.
Okay, I will be sure to sell some lacquer boxes.
Okay, I will be sure to buy some lacquer boxes.

question.text: 7. I bought plane tickets on Econo-Airlines, and a few days later they went belly up!

options.option: I'm sure you'll have a great flight.
I'll be sure to book my next flight with Econo-Airlines.
That's too bad. You'd better buy some new plane tickets.

question.text: 8. Working on Wall Street for an investment bank sounds wonderful, but it's not all it's cracked up to be.

options.option: You're right. It really is wonderful.
You're right. The pay is good, but the work is demanding and the hours are long.
You're right. Everybody I know who works on Wall Street loves it.
